regions.full_page: Afriend of your Daughter Jenny's, Miss Rose Faris, writes me that Jenny is very low with poleo and asks for prayers, that if it be God's holy will she recover. I am enrolling Jenny in what we call the Seraphic Mass Association for prayers of hundreds of thousands of people. The members of this association are asked to pray for our foreign mission- aries and their work and for oneanother; those members ofcourse who can pray. Also those who can afforde to do so are asked to help with an offer- ing of somekind besides by prayers and Masses. I am confident that this will help your Jenny. This especially if you and yours do your part. You will get an idea of what I mean by telling you of a remarkable case in Detroit about four years ago. I made a note of it at the time which was about as follows. "Jan. 9th. Judge Mealy called this evening: 1 ... There is a cer- tain Dr. Kleitzer in my office whose only child is very low with spinal meningitis and the Dr's give him very little hope of re- covery. Ne is not a Catholic or a Christian. He is a Jew, a good, God fearing fellow. 'I wish you would enroll the boy in the Mass Association and pray for him. "I'll be glad to do that." I an- swered. "Tell the parents I'd like to see them." "I'll bring them over tomorrow." he answered" "Next day (Saturday), I saw them - the judge and the Dr. waiting over in the corner about 1:15 p.m." Introduced to the doctor.I asked," .. How is the boy?" "Well, he slept last night!" ( the first time in a week) .... "How Dr., I have a proposition I want you to make to the Good God yourself. "I understand you're a Jew." "Yes." "That is Okay Dr. After all if religion can be defined as a science and I claim it is unquestionably the greatest science of all times; In fact it is nothing less than THE SCIENCE OF OUR HAPPY RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD AND OUR NEIGHBOR. ", then there can be but one religion, though there may be a thousand different systems of re- ligion." .... "Dr. seemed pleased but said nothing.

regions.full_page: Dear Madam Trabulsy: God bless you and yours. I hope you are well.
